liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (4 reviews): Reviewer singles out the Scarlet>Fire as sitting in an unusual slot in the show, and enjoys that placement; After a slow second set of newer tunes, the Scarlet>Fire was very well played, with a favorite jam [16][17][21][23]
- **Loose Lucy** (3 reviews): Described as still fresh in the repertoire at this show, and part of a decent first set; Reviewer also liked the Loose Lucy [17][22][23]
- **Cold Rain & Snow** (2 reviews): Opening with this in unbearable heat amused the reviewer, who expected a more obvious opener; The Cold Rain opener is seen as nicely sarcastic given the heat [17][26]
- **Just A Little Light** (1 review): Brent's wailing on this song is called the highlight of his career; he had little time left [19]
- **Loser** (1 review): Reviewer finds Loser the nice moment in an otherwise tepid show [20]
- **The Wheel** (1 review): Reviewer considers this one of the best versions of The Wheel [22]

## The recordings

- **gd90-07-04.sbd.miller.26351.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 165 min; rated 3.87/5 by 30 [1]
- **gd1990-07-04.154442.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 169 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [6]. Said about its sound: Bad cable in set 2 affected the right channel only; left channel was pasted over it; Soundboard feed was turned off for U.S. Blues, leaving only ambient mics [6]
- **gd1990-07-04.153738.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 20 songs; 169 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [7]. Said about its sound: A bad cable in set 2 hit the right channel; the left channel was pasted over those spots; Soundboard feed to the ultra box was off for U.S. Blues, so only ambient mics are heard [7]
- **gd1990-07-04.sbd.miller.tetzeli.fix-26351.81523.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 170 min; rated 3.5/5 by 12 [8]. Said about its sound: Uploader calls both this soundboard and the audience source excellent recordings [8]

## Around the show

- Around 105 degrees at showtime, with the stage facing west; Jerry wore shorts and kept wiping his guitar neck [18]
- First set was short; Weir said the band would return when it cooled off, and the ground turned to mud [18]
- Afterwards the parking lot became a chaotic fireworks war among adults behaving childishly [18]
- About 106 degrees at showtime; the heat sent many people to the medics with heat exhaustion [19]
- Reviewer's last time seeing Brent before his death; heat was unbearable, with garden hoses and mud slides around [21]
- Parking lot after the show turned into a bottle rocket and roman candle war [22]
- Reviewer rates it the best start to any Dead tour [19]
- Reviewer says better shows exist from summer 1990 [20]
- Reviewer says this show had tremendous energy compared with later Dead shows they saw [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd90-07-04.sbd.miller.26351.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> Dat> Cassette Master [1]. Also: Soundboard to DAT to cassette master, then transferred through ART DIO at 24bit/96k and Sound Forge 7; Burned to CD, extracted with EAC and converted to SHN by Charlie Miller [1]
- **gd1990-07-04.154442.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  October 4, 2021; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-X90) [6]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; multiple masters were used to make the show complete [6]
- **gd1990-07-04.153738.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  October 4, 2021; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-X90) [7]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; multiple masters were combined to complete the show [7]
- **gd1990-07-04.sbd.miller.tetzeli.fix-26351.81523.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: Patched fix of shnid 26351 [8]. Also: Patched in about five and a half minutes of drums from the Ladner audience recording (shnid 8573) [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Sandstone Amphitheatre - July 4, 1990](https://www.dead.net/show/july-4-1990) [29]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Sandstone Amphitheatre - July 4, 1990](https://www.dead.net/show/july-4-1990) [30]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1990-07-04 Sandstone Ampitheatre, Bonner Springs, KS, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1990-07-04-sandstone-ampitheatre-bonner-springs-ks-usa/) [31]
